title: Proof-path approval re-checks and the resolver total-byte cap have no killing test: removing record.bindingHash / record.hostScopeHash compares in prepareApprovalProofAuthorize, the proof-side authorization.bindingHash and attempt-vs-input tenant compares, or the resolver totalBytes cap leaves all focused suites green
evidence: Checker D-020 mutation run (38 mutants, 31 killed). Survivors that are NOT equivalent in-module: A7 registration-approval-authority.ts:54 drop `record.bindingHash !== attempt.bindingHash` (authorize then returns the ATTEMPT binding at :56, so zoom-registration-proof.ts:131 cannot catch it); A8 registration-approval-authority.ts:55 drop `record.hostScopeHash !== hostScopeHash` (:56-57 returns the computed hostScopeHash). Defense-in-depth survivors: Z2 zoom-registration-proof.ts:131 authorization.bindingHash compare; Z5 zoom-registration-proof.ts:122 attempt.tenantId !== input.tenantId; R5 registration-link-resolver.ts:131 totalBytes > 1 MiB (the only resolver-level test, registration-provider-candidates.test.ts:141, is refused for the target reason on the initial host, not the cap). Code is correct at this SHA: the store query (apps/api/src/registration-approvals/store.ts:149, tested by registration-approvals.test.ts:80-89) filters every proof hash, the real transport caps bytes (mutant R6 killed), and an independent checker probe with a lying lookup row refused bindingHash/hostScopeHash/policyRevision/policyHash/tenant/revoked/expired/over-30-day rows. No production RegistrationApprovalLookup adapter exists yet, so a future adapter defect would leave these re-checks as the only guard.
fix_direction: Add to registration-approval-authority.test.ts a lying-lookup test for prepareApprovalProofAuthorize mirroring the resolver one at :62-69 (bindingHash, hostScopeHash, policyRevision, policyHash, tenant, revoked, expiry, 30-day bound); add a proof test with an authorize that returns a mismatched bindingHash and one with a foreign-tenant attempt plus permissive authorize; add a resolver test where the FINAL zoom.us 200 response body pushes totalBytes over 1 MiB via the get double. Verify each by re-running the A7/A8/Z2/Z5/R5 mutants.
